question: What’s the nearest restaurant along the travel direction from Bowditch Middle School Auditorium, Foster City, CA to Serge Sorokko Gallery, San Francisco, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.248613 37.559053)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.405733 37.790349)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.248613 37.559053)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.248613 37.559053)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Bowditch Middle School Auditorium, Foster City, CA

[3].display_name: Serge Sorokko Gallery, San Francisco, CA
